subject: Setting regular CRAN archive (message at startup)

messages.author: 92e7f2d893912986
messages.subject: Setting regular CRAN archive (message at startup)
parts:
I've just installed Revolution R Open 3.2.0 on Windows 7 (64 bit).

Currently I prefer to use the most recent CRAN updates.  I've created an .Rprofile file in my home directory that contains:

options(repos = c(CRAN = "http://cran.revolutionanalytics.com"))

However, when I start RRO, I continue to get the message at startup:

"Using CRAN snapshot taken on 2015-05-01"

Should this message not go away when using a regular CRAN archive?

Thanks.  --Dale

messages.author: 34c17809e30c516f
messages.subject: Re: Setting regular CRAN archive (message at startup)
parts:
Hi,

I think this is 'hard coded' message in Rprofile.site

cat("Using CRAN snapshot taken on 2015-05-01\n",sep="")

Cheers,

Milos.
